advisory: The mandate is advisory: it is stored by this Petal and the agent can edit it. It filters bad drafts before the owner is asked; every vote still needs the owner's approval in a passkey ceremony. An owner-signed, binding mandate is future work.
notes: Every vote still needs the owner's approval in a passkey ceremony: writing a suggested_write body only starts that request.
The mandate still applies when the body is written (allowed spaces, blocked keywords, require_reason, daily limit), so a body shown here can be refused.
Listed: open proposals of a supported type that the delegate voted on and this account has not. Nothing here votes automatically.
vote_id is derived from the proposal: if that vote_id already ended (expired, rejected) or the delegate changed its choice, write under a new vote_id.
